subject: Horizon Health — credit allocation and withholding coordination
messages:
From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Billing discrepancy & VAT withholding on March invoice

Hi Rafael,

We noticed a discrepancy on Invoice #77019 (March 2027). Our AP team has flagged two items: a service line billed at the wrong unit rate and an instance where EU withholding was applied by our payroll team instead of being treated as a gross-to-gross refund. Attached is the invoice and our remittance note.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue a split credit (service credit + VAT correction) and whether you can provide a credit note that our AP system can apply net of withholding? Horizon requires either a gross credit plus withholding proof or a net credit that matches the withheld amount — we can’t apply partial manual adjustments easily.

Files attached: Invoice_Mar2027_77019.pdf, RemittanceNote_Horizon_Mar.pdf

Thanks — we’re trying to close the month and would appreciate a quick turnaround.

Best,
Lisa Gomez
Director, Accounts Payable
Horizon Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy & VAT withholding on March invoice

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear note and the remittance file.

I’ve looped in Ben (finance) and Laura (your account lead). We’ll investigate the rate line and determine the correct credit split. Two quick things we need from you to speed this up:

- Confirm whether Horizon prefers the credit issued gross (we then supply withholding evidence) or net (Redwood issues a reduced credit amount so it maps directly to your AP system).
- If you choose gross, please confirm the withholding percentage and whether you’ll accept Redwood’s Form 616/Withholding Evidence PDF.

Ben — can you prepare a provisional credit note and a suggested breakdown (service credit, VAT reversal, withholding offset)? Laura — please add any contract clauses we should reference for this account.

We’ll aim to have a provisional credit out within 24–48 hours, pending Ben’s calc. If that works for Horizon, we can also prepare a DocuSign acceptance to keep your AP workflow intact.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales — EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@horizonhealth.com>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:43:00 +0000
Subject: Provisional credit note (invoice 77019)

Hi Lisa and team —

Attached is a provisional credit note and our working calculation: Provisional_Credit_4491.pdf (PDF). Summary below:

- Invoice: 77019 (period: Mar 2027)
- Identified overcharge: service line "realtime-ingest" billed at 0.075 per unit instead of contracted 0.050 -> gross overcharge 22,500.00 EUR
- VAT reversal on the overcharged amount (20%) -> 4,500.00 EUR
- Total gross credit available: 27,000.00 EUR

We understand Horizon applied withholding of 10% at source on the refunded value (2,700.00 EUR). Redwood can handle this two ways:

A) Issue a gross credit note for 27,000.00 EUR and provide withholding evidence (signed forms + transaction trace) so Horizon can reflect a net position internally.

B) Issue a net credit of 24,300.00 EUR (gross less 10% withholding) that Horizon can apply directly in your AP system.

Operational note: option (B) reduces manual steps for your team but will require us to mark the ledger differently for tax reporting. If Horizon prefers (B), please confirm explicitly and indicate whether we should record the credit as "net of withholding" in your account history.

Attachments included: Provisional_Credit_4491.pdf, Withholding_Evidence_Horizon.pdf

Next steps we need from Horizon:
- Confirm gross vs net preference
- If gross, confirm the withholding percentage and the legal entity that applied it (we need that for our tax records)
- Whether you require a DocuSign acceptance of the credit note for your AP workflow (we can send this immediately)

Laura — tagging you to help with acceptance and to confirm any SLA goodwill credit we should include.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Lead, Customer Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Gomez <lisa.gomez@horizonhealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:09:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Provisional credit note (invoice 77019)

Hi Ben / Rafael,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed calc. Horizon confirms option B — we need a net credit issued for 24,300.00 EUR so our AP system can apply it automatically. The withholding was applied by our payroll/legal entity "Horizon Group EU Services" (registration VX-449-77); attached is a short confirmation from them (Withholding_Evidence_Horizon.pdf).

Please proceed with:
- Final credit note for 24,300.00 EUR, labeled "net of withholding", with the credit reference 4491.
- DocuSign link for our AP team to accept the credit note (we require a signed document to post in our ledger).
- Remittance advice email to accounts-payable@horizonhealth.com when the credit is posted.

We’d appreciate posting the credit before COB tomorrow if possible — month-end close is tomorrow and this will help our reconciliation.

Thanks,
Lisa Gomez
Director, Accounts Payable
Horizon Health
